title: gochnatia buchii
intro: Gochnatia buchii, commonly known as the "Tournesol" or "Mexican Marigold", is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Gochnatia buchii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
